name: whatsapp-automation
description: WhatsApp 6-message sequence automation via GreenAPI, driven by Excel (original.xlsx)

scripts.check:node: node -e "const [major,minor]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); const ok=(major>20)||(major===20&&minor>=19); if(!ok){console.error('ERROR: Node.js 20.19+ is required. Current: '+process.versions.node+'. Upgrade Node runtime for Vite 8/React Router 7 build compatibility.'); process.exit(1);} console.log('Node version OK:', process.versions.node);"
scripts.build: npm run check:node && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: npm run check:node && node scripts/check-env.js && node server.js
